hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN RESHMI KEBAB

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN TIKKA

hasMenuItem.name: CHILI CHICKEN

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN MANCHURIAN

hasMenuItem.name: VEG MANCHURIAN GRAVY
hasMenuItem.description: Crispy vegetable dumplings made from cabbage, carrots, and spices, simmered in a tangy, spicy Indo-Chinese gravy with garlic, soy, and chili flavors. Best enjoyed with fried rice or noodles.

hasMenuItem.name: KASHMIRI DUM ALOO
hasMenuItem.description: Small, baby potatoes slow-cooked in a fragrant, rich gravy made with yogurt, aromatic spices, and Kashmiri red chili. This dish offers a perfect balance of heat and creaminess, bringing the flavors of Kashmir to your plate in every bite.

This sweet and savory dish is delicately spiced and indulgently creamy, perfect for those seeking a vegetarian treat.

hasMenuItem.name: VEG DIWANI HANDI
hasMenuItem.description: A vibrant, mixed vegetable curry cooked in a rich, creamy gravy with a perfect balance of spices and herbs. Served in a traditional handi, this dish is both comforting and packed with flavors.

hasMenuItem.name: AMRITSARI CHOLE
hasMenuItem.description: A traditional Punjabi specialty made with chickpeas simmered in a robust blend of onions, tomatoes, ginger, and aromatic spices. Rich, flavorful, and best enjoyed with bhature, naan, or rice.

hasMenuItem.name: SAAG CHANA

hasMenuItem.name: CHANA MASALA

hasMenuItem.name: SAAG PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: Soft cubes of paneer immersed in a velvety spinach gravy, spiced with garam masala and cumin. This classic North Indian dish is both creamy and full of flavor, offering a perfect balance of richness and warmth.

hasMenuItem.name: METHI MALAI MATAR
hasMenuItem.description: Soft cubes of paneer cooked in a creamy, fragrant gravy made with fenugreek leaves (methi), fresh cream, and aromatic spices. hasMenuItem.name: JAIN PANEER BUTTER MASALA

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN MATAR PANEER

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN METHI MALAI PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: A comforting Jain classic made with tender paneer and aromatic methi, simmered in a smooth, mildly sweet cream-based gravy.

hasMenuItem.name: SAAG CHICKEN

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN BHUNA

hasMenuItem.name: DESI CHICKEN

hasMenuItem.name: MUTTON CURRY
hasMenuItem.description: Hearty pieces of mutton simmered in a rich and flavorful curry sauce made with tomatoes, onions, and an array of spices. The tender meat is infused with the savory spices, creating a comforting, aromatic dish that's perfect with steamed rice or naan.

hasMenuItem.description: A Kashmiri classic, this dish features tender mutton simmered in a rich, yogurt-based gravy with aromatic spices such as saffron and cinnamon. The dish offers a delicate, slightly spicy flavor profile that’s velvety and deeply fragrant, making it a truly indulgent meal.

hasMenuItem.name: BULLET NAAN

hasMenuItem.name: VEG BIRYANI
hasMenuItem.description: Fragrant basmati rice layered with a medley of mixed vegetables and aromatic spices, cooked to perfection. This aromatic, flavorful dish is served with a side of cooling raita to balance the heat.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN DUM BIRYAN

hasMenuItem.name: MUTTON BIRYANI

hasMenuItem.name: JEERA RICE
hasMenuItem.description: Fragrant basmati rice cooked with cumin seeds, giving it a warm, earthy flavor with a light, aromatic fragrance. A simple yet perfect accompaniment to any curry or dish, offering a comforting balance of spices and texture.

hasMenuItem.name: STEAMED RICE
hasMenuItem.description: Fragrant, fluffy basmati rice, perfectly steamed to a light and airy texture. A classic side dish that complements any curry or gravy.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN NUGGETS & FRIES
hasMenuItem.description: Crispy golden chicken nuggets served with a side of hot French fries. A kid’s all-time favorite meal, simple and tasty.

hasMenuItem.name: MANGO LASSI
hasMenuItem.description: A refreshing blend of ripe mangoes and creamy yogurt, sweetened to perfection and chilled for a smooth, velvety texture. This tropical, tangy-sweet drink is the perfect way to cool down and complement any meal.

hasMenuItem.name: MASALA CHAAS
hasMenuItem.description: A light and refreshing yogurt-based drink seasoned with roasted cumin, ginger, green chili, and fresh coriander. Served chilled, this spiced buttermilk is the perfect cooling companion to any meal. ?

hasMenuItem.name: RAS MALAI
hasMenuItem.description: Soft paneer soaked in rich, sweetened cream, delicately flavored with cardamom and saffron. A creamy, indulgent dessert to finish your meal.

hasMenuItem.name: CARROT HALVA
hasMenuItem.description: A traditional Indian dessert made with grated carrots slow-cooked in milk, sugar, and ghee, flavored with cardamom, and garnished with nuts. A rich and comforting sweet treat.

hasMenuItem.name: GULAB JAMUN
hasMenuItem.description: Soft, melt-in-your-mouth milk-solid dumplings soaked in warm cardamom-infused sugar syrup. Served slightly warm for the perfect end to your meal.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN RESHMI KEBAB

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN TIKKA

hasMenuItem.name: GOBI MANCHURIAN

hasMenuItem.name: BABY CORN CHILI

hasMenuItem.name: VEG MANCHURIAN DRY

hasMenuItem.name: PANEER CHILI
hasMenuItem.description: A spicy, tangy Indo-Chinese delight, this dish features paneer cubes tossed in a bold, wok-fried sauce with bell peppers, onions, and chili sauce. With a crispy exterior and a hint of sweetness, it’s a perfect balance of heat and flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: CHILI CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: Crispy fried chicken tossed with onions, bell peppers, green chilies, garlic, and soy sauce in a spicy Indo-Chinese style. Available in dry or gravy preparation, perfect with fried rice or noodles.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN MANCHURIAN
hasMenuItem.description: Crispy chicken pieces tossed in a tangy, spicy Indo-Chinese sauce made with garlic, soy, chili, and spring onions. Perfect with fried rice or noodles.

hasMenuItem.name: VEG FRIED RICE
hasMenuItem.description: Fragrant basmati rice stir-fried with mixed vegetables, soy sauce, and a blend of spices, creating a light, savory dish. A perfect side to any curry or Indo-Chinese dish.

hasMenuItem.name: EGG FRIED RICE
hasMenuItem.description: Fragrant basmati rice stir-fried with scrambled eggs, fresh vegetables, soy sauce, and spices. A simple yet flavorful Indo-Chinese classic.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN FRIED RICE
hasMenuItem.description: Fragrant basmati rice stir-fried with tender chicken, fresh vegetables, soy sauce, and spices. A classic Indo-Chinese favorite, perfect on its own or paired with gravy dishes.

hasMenuItem.name: VEG FRIED NOODLES
hasMenuItem.description: Stir-fried noodles tossed with fresh vegetables, soy sauce, and a medley of spices. This Indo-Chinese favorite is a savory, satisfying dish with a perfect balance of crispy and tender textures.

hasMenuItem.name: VEG SCHEZWAN RICE
hasMenuItem.description: Fragrant basmati rice stir-fried with vegetables and Schezwan sauce, delivering a tangy, garlicky, and spicy Indo-Chinese taste.

hasMenuItem.name: VEG SCHEZWAN NOODLES
hasMenuItem.description: Spicy stir-fried noodles with garden-fresh vegetables in a fiery Schezwan sauce made with chili, garlic, and bold spices. Perfect for spice lovers.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN SCHEZWAN RICE

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN FRIED NOODLES

hasMenuItem.name: EGG FRIED NOODLES

hasMenuItem.name: GOBI MANCHURIAN GRAVY

hasMenuItem.name: VEG MANCHURIAN GRAVY
hasMenuItem.description: Crispy vegetable dumplings made from cabbage, carrots, and spices, simmered in a tangy, spicy Indo-Chinese gravy with garlic, soy, and chili flavors. Best enjoyed with fried rice or noodles.

hasMenuItem.name: KASHMIRI DUM ALOO
hasMenuItem.description: Small, baby potatoes slow-cooked in a fragrant, rich gravy made with yogurt, aromatic spices, and Kashmiri red chili. This dish offers a perfect balance of heat and creaminess, bringing the flavors of Kashmir to your plate in every bite.

hasMenuItem.name: NAVRATNA KORMA
hasMenuItem.description: A royal, creamy curry made with a medley of nine different vegetables and fruits, including carrots, beans, and pineapple, all simmered in a rich, spiced gravy of yogurt, cream, and cashew paste. This sweet and savory dish is delicately spiced and indulgently creamy, perfect for those seeking a vegetarian treat.

hasMenuItem.name: MUSHROOM MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: A rich, flavorful curry featuring tender mushrooms cooked in a spiced gravy of tomatoes, onions, and aromatic spices. The earthy mushrooms absorb the aromatic masala, creating a hearty and satisfying vegetarian dish that's both comforting and packed with flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: VEG DIWANI HANDI
hasMenuItem.description: A vibrant, mixed vegetable curry cooked in a rich, creamy gravy with a perfect balance of spices and herbs. Served in a traditional handi, this dish is both comforting and packed with flavors.

hasMenuItem.name: AMRITSARI CHOLE
hasMenuItem.description: A traditional Punjabi specialty made with chickpeas simmered in a robust blend of onions, tomatoes, ginger, and aromatic spices. Rich, flavorful, and best enjoyed with bhature, naan, or rice.

hasMenuItem.name: SAAG CHANA
hasMenuItem.description: Tender chickpeas cooked in a rich, spiced spinach gravy. The earthy flavor of the chickpeas blends perfectly with the smooth, mildly spiced saag, creating a hearty and comforting dish.

hasMenuItem.name: CHANA MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: A hearty North Indian curry made with chickpeas simmered in onions, tomatoes, ginger, and a blend of traditional spices. A flavorful vegetarian favorite, best enjoyed with rice or bread.

hasMenuItem.name: ALOO GOBI MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: A classic North Indian curry made with potatoes and cauliflower cooked in onions, tomatoes, ginger, and traditional spices. A hearty vegetarian favorite with homestyle flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: METHI MALAI MATAR
hasMenuItem.description: A rich, creamy dish featuring tender green peas (matar) and fenugreek leaves (methi) cooked in a luscious, spiced gravy. The bitterness of methi is beautifully balanced with the sweetness of peas, creating a warm, satisfying curry.

hasMenuItem.name: MALAI KOFTA
hasMenuItem.description: Velvety spheres of paneer and potato, subtly spiced and cooked to perfection, immersed in a rich, creamy tomato-based gravy. The silky texture of the kofta combined with the luscious, aromatic sauce creates a decadent, indulgent dish that’s both comforting and flavorful.

hasMenuItem.name: KADAI PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: Soft cubes of paneer cooked in a fiery, tangy gravy made with bell peppers, onions, tomatoes, and a special blend of spices. The dish is simmered in a wok (kadai), which infuses the curry with a smoky depth, creating a vegetarian delight that’s rich in flavor and texture.

hasMenuItem.name: SAAG PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: Soft cubes of paneer immersed in a velvety spinach gravy, spiced with garam masala and cumin. This classic North Indian dish is both creamy and full of flavor, offering a perfect balance of richness and warmth.

hasMenuItem.name: PANEER BHURJI
hasMenuItem.description: Crumbled paneer cooked with onions, tomatoes, and a medley of spices. This savory, scrambled paneer dish is seasoned with cumin, turmeric, and garam masala, creating a hearty, flavorful dish that’s perfect for breakfast, lunch, or as a side.

hasMenuItem.name: MATAR PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: A classic North Indian dish featuring soft cubes of paneer and tender green peas simmered in a rich, spiced tomato-based gravy. Infused with warming spices like cumin, coriander, and garam masala, this comforting curry strikes the perfect balance between creamy, savory, and slightly sweet flavors.

hasMenuItem.name: VEDA SPECIAL PANEER LAVABDAR
hasMenuItem.description: Soft cubes of paneer cooked in a creamy, flavorful gravy made with tomatoes, onions, and a unique blend of spices. The dish is mildly spiced and indulgently smooth, making it a must-try vegetarian delicacy.

hasMenuItem.name: PANEER ANGARA
hasMenuItem.description: Chunks of paneer marinated in a smoky, spicy blend of yogurt and masalas, then grilled to perfection. The fiery flavors of the marinade, combined with the charred, smoky exterior, make this a flavorful and satisfying vegetarian appetizer.

hasMenuItem.name: METHI MALAI MATAR
hasMenuItem.description: Soft cubes of paneer cooked in a creamy, fragrant gravy made with fenugreek leaves (methi), fresh cream, and aromatic spices. This rich and savory dish balances the slight bitterness of methi with the smooth creaminess, offering a comforting and indulgent vegetarian delight.

hasMenuItem.name: PANEER BUTTER MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: Creamy, rich, and indulgent, this dish features soft cubes of paneer simmered in a velvety tomato-based gravy with butter, cream, and a delicate blend of spices. A classic favorite that pairs beautifully with naan or rice.

hasMenuItem.name: PANEER TIKKA MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: Tender cubes of marinated paneer grilled to perfection and then simmered in a rich, spiced tomato gravy. The dish is creamy, aromatic, and full of flavor, making it a favorite vegetarian curry in Indian cuisine.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN PANEER TIKKA MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: Char-grilled paneer tikka pieces simmered in a rich, creamy tomato-cashew gravy, delicately spiced for a flavorful Jain preparation.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN PANEER BUTTER MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: Soft paneer cubes simmered in a rich, buttery tomato-cashew gravy, finished with fresh cream for a smooth, mildly sweet Jain preparation.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN MATAR PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: Tender paneer cubes and green peas cooked in a mildly spiced tomato-based gravy, finished with a touch of cream.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN METHI MALAI PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: A comforting Jain classic made with tender paneer and aromatic methi, simmered in a smooth, mildly sweet cream-based gravy.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN METHI MALAI MATAR
hasMenuItem.description: Fresh methi leaves and tender green peas cooked in a velvety malai gravy, balanced with subtle spices to create a comforting and aromatic Jain-friendly dish.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN MALAI KOFTA
hasMenuItem.description: Soft paneer and vegetable koftas served in a rich, creamy cashew-malai gravy, delicately spiced for a smooth and comforting flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: VEDA SPECIAL CHICKEN CURRY
hasMenuItem.description: Juicy, tender chicken simmered in a rich, aromatic gravy made from freshly ground spices, tomatoes, and a hint of cream. This signature curry is deeply flavorful with a perfect balance of heat and warmth, offering a comforting, authentic taste of India.

hasMenuItem.name: BUTTER CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: Juicy pieces of chicken cooked in a smooth tomato-butter sauce with cream and mild spices. A signature Indian favorite that’s rich, comforting, and mildly spiced.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN TIKKA MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: ender pieces of marinated chicken, roasted in the tandoor, then simmered in a rich and creamy tomato-onion sauce with aromatic spices. A classic North Indian favorite with bold flavor and smooth texture.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN LAVABDAR
hasMenuItem.description: Boneless chicken pieces cooked in a rich, creamy tomato and cashew-based gravy with aromatic spices. A mildly spiced North Indian delicacy, known for its smooth texture and royal flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: SAAG CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: Tender chicken simmered in a creamy spinach gravy with garlic, ginger, and mild spices. A hearty North Indian classic that blends rich flavor with wholesome greens.

hasMenuItem.name: KADAI CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: A flavorful North Indian curry made with tender chicken cooked in a wok-style pan (kadai) with onions, tomatoes, capsicum, and freshly ground spices. Known for its bold, smoky flavor and medium spice kick.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN BHUNA
hasMenuItem.description: Tender chicken cooked with onions, tomatoes, ginger, garlic, and a thick blend of aromatic spices. A rich, semi-dry curry known for its deep flavor and slow-cooked taste.

hasMenuItem.name: DESI CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: Traditional homestyle chicken curry cooked with bone-in pieces, onions, tomatoes, ginger, garlic, and a blend of rustic Indian spices. A flavorful dish that brings the authentic taste of Indian kitchens.

hasMenuItem.name: MUTTON CURRY
hasMenuItem.description: Hearty pieces of mutton simmered in a rich and flavorful curry sauce made with tomatoes, onions, and an array of spices. The tender meat is infused with the savory spices, creating a comforting, aromatic dish that's perfect with steamed rice or naan.

hasMenuItem.name: MUTTON ROGAN JOSH
hasMenuItem.description: A Kashmiri classic, this dish features tender mutton simmered in a rich, yogurt-based gravy with aromatic spices such as saffron and cinnamon. The dish offers a delicate, slightly spicy flavor profile that’s velvety and deeply fragrant, making it a truly indulgent meal.

hasMenuItem.name: KADAI MUTTON

hasMenuItem.name: LAMB CURRY

hasMenuItem.name: LAMB ROGAN JOSH

hasMenuItem.name: VEDA SPCIAL LAMB

hasMenuItem.name: LAMB BHUNA

hasMenuItem.name: VEDA SPECIAL DAL
hasMenuItem.description: A rich, hearty blend of lentils cooked with aromatic spices, tomatoes, and a dash of ghee, creating a comforting and flavorful dal. This house special is perfect with steamed rice or naan.

hasMenuItem.name: DAL MAKHNI

hasMenuItem.name: DAL TADKA

hasMenuItem.name: PLAIN NAAN

hasMenuItem.name: GARLIC NAAN

hasMenuItem.name: GARLIC CHILLI NAAN

hasMenuItem.name: BUTTER NAAN

hasMenuItem.name: BULLET NAAN

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN DUM BIRYAN

hasMenuItem.name: MUTTON BIRYANI

hasMenuItem.name: JEERA RICE
hasMenuItem.description: Fragrant basmati rice cooked with cumin seeds, giving it a warm, earthy flavor with a light, aromatic fragrance. A simple yet perfect accompaniment to any curry or dish, offering a comforting balance of spices and texture.

hasMenuItem.name: STEAMED RICE
hasMenuItem.description: Fragrant, fluffy basmati rice, perfectly steamed to a light and airy texture. A classic side dish that complements any curry or gravy.

hasMenuItem.name: FRENCH FRIES

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN NUGGETS & FRIES
hasMenuItem.description: Crispy golden chicken nuggets served with a side of hot French fries. A kid’s all-time favorite meal, simple and tasty.

hasMenuItem.name: MANGO LASSI
hasMenuItem.description: A refreshing blend of ripe mangoes and creamy yogurt, sweetened to perfection and chilled for a smooth, velvety texture. This tropical, tangy-sweet drink is the perfect way to cool down and complement any meal.

hasMenuItem.name: MASALA CHAAS
hasMenuItem.description: A light and refreshing yogurt-based drink seasoned with roasted cumin, ginger, green chili, and fresh coriander. Served chilled, this spiced buttermilk is the perfect cooling companion to any meal. ?

hasMenuItem.name: RAS MALAI
hasMenuItem.description: Soft paneer soaked in rich, sweetened cream, delicately flavored with cardamom and saffron. A creamy, indulgent dessert to finish your meal.

hasMenuItem.name: CARROT HALVA
hasMenuItem.description: A traditional Indian dessert made with grated carrots slow-cooked in milk, sugar, and ghee, flavored with cardamom, and garnished with nuts. A rich and comforting sweet treat.

hasMenuItem.name: GULAB JAMUN
hasMenuItem.description: Soft, melt-in-your-mouth milk-solid dumplings soaked in warm cardamom-infused sugar syrup. Served slightly warm for the perfect end to your meal.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN 65

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN LOLIPOP DRY

hasMenuItem.name: GARLIC SHRIMP

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN LOLIPOP GRAVY

hasMenuItem.name: TANDOORI CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: Juicy chicken marinated in a blend of yogurt, spices, and herbs, then char-grilled to perfection in the tandoor. The smoky, spiced exterior and tender meat make this a classic favorite.

hasMenuItem.name: LAMB SEEKH KABAB
hasMenuItem.description: Minced lamb mixed with fresh herbs, spices, and a touch of yogurt, then shaped onto skewers and grilled to perfection. These juicy, flavorful kababs are tender on the inside, with a smoky, charred exterior, served with a side of tangy chutney.

hasMenuItem.name: LAMB CHOP

hasMenuItem.name: TANDOORI SHRIMP

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN RESHMI KEBAB
hasMenuItem.description: ender chicken pieces marinated in yogurt, cream, and mild spices, then grilled in the tandoor for a soft, juicy, and melt-in-the-mouth kebab. A rich and flavorful Mughlai delicacy.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN TIKKA
hasMenuItem.description: Boneless pieces of chicken marinated in a spiced yogurt mixture, skewered, and grilled to perfection in the tandoor. With a crispy, smoky exterior and juicy interior, this flavorful dish is a crowd-pleaser.

hasMenuItem.name: GOBI MANCHURIAN
hasMenuItem.description: Crispy cauliflower florets tossed in a tangy Indo-Chinese sauce with garlic, ginger, soy, and spring onions. A bold and addictive street-style favorite with just the right balance of heat and flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: BABY CORN CHILI

hasMenuItem.name: VEG MANCHURIAN DRY

hasMenuItem.name: PANEER CHILI

hasMenuItem.name: CHILI CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: Crispy fried chicken tossed with onions, bell peppers, green chilies, garlic, and soy sauce in a spicy Indo-Chinese style. Available in dry or gravy preparation, perfect with fried rice or noodles.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN MANCHURIAN
hasMenuItem.description: Crispy chicken pieces tossed in a tangy, spicy Indo-Chinese sauce made with garlic, soy, chili, and spring onions. Perfect with fried rice or noodles.

hasMenuItem.name: VEG FRIED RICE

hasMenuItem.name: EGG FRIED RICE
hasMenuItem.description: Fragrant basmati rice stir-fried with scrambled eggs, fresh vegetables, soy sauce, and spices. A simple yet flavorful Indo-Chinese classic.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN FRIED RICE
hasMenuItem.description: Fragrant basmati rice stir-fried with tender chicken, fresh vegetables, soy sauce, and spices. A classic Indo-Chinese favorite, perfect on its own or paired with gravy dishes.

hasMenuItem.name: VEG FRIED NOODLES

hasMenuItem.name: VEG SCHEZWAN RICE

hasMenuItem.name: VEG SCHEZWAN NOODLES

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN FRIED NOODLES

hasMenuItem.name: GOBI MANCHURIAN GRAVY
hasMenuItem.description: Golden-fried cauliflower florets tossed in a flavorful Indo-Chinese gravy made with garlic, ginger, soy, and chili sauce. A spicy, tangy favorite that pairs perfectly with fried rice or noodles.

hasMenuItem.name: VEG MANCHURIAN GRAVY
hasMenuItem.description: Crispy vegetable dumplings made from cabbage, carrots, and spices, simmered in a tangy, spicy Indo-Chinese gravy with garlic, soy, and chili flavors. Best enjoyed with fried rice or noodles.

hasMenuItem.name: KASHMIRI DUM ALOO
hasMenuItem.description: Small, baby potatoes slow-cooked in a fragrant, rich gravy made with yogurt, aromatic spices, and Kashmiri red chili. This dish offers a perfect balance of heat and creaminess, bringing the flavors of Kashmir to your plate in every bite.

hasMenuItem.name: NAVRATNA KORMA
hasMenuItem.description: A royal, creamy curry made with a medley of nine different vegetables and fruits, including carrots, beans, and pineapple, all simmered in a rich, spiced gravy of yogurt, cream, and cashew paste. This sweet and savory dish is delicately spiced and indulgently creamy, perfect for those seeking a vegetarian treat.

hasMenuItem.name: VEG DIWANI HANDI
hasMenuItem.description: A vibrant, mixed vegetable curry cooked in a rich, creamy gravy with a perfect balance of spices and herbs. Served in a traditional handi, this dish is both comforting and packed with flavors.

hasMenuItem.description: A traditional Punjabi specialty made with chickpeas simmered in a robust blend of onions, tomatoes, ginger, and aromatic spices. Rich, flavorful, and best enjoyed with bhature, naan, or rice.

hasMenuItem.name: SAAG CHANA
hasMenuItem.description: Tender chickpeas cooked in a rich, spiced spinach gravy. The earthy flavor of the chickpeas blends perfectly with the smooth, mildly spiced saag, creating a hearty and comforting dish.

hasMenuItem.name: CHANA MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: A hearty North Indian curry made with chickpeas simmered in onions, tomatoes, ginger, and a blend of traditional spices. A flavorful vegetarian favorite, best enjoyed with rice or bread.

hasMenuItem.name: ALOO GOBI MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: A classic North Indian curry made with potatoes and cauliflower cooked in onions, tomatoes, ginger, and traditional spices. A hearty vegetarian favorite with homestyle flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: MALAI KOFTA

hasMenuItem.name: KADAI PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: Soft cubes of paneer cooked in a fiery, tangy gravy made with bell peppers, onions, tomatoes, and a special blend of spices. The dish is simmered in a wok (kadai), which infuses the curry with a smoky depth, creating a vegetarian delight that’s rich in flavor and texture.

hasMenuItem.name: SAAG PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: Soft cubes of paneer immersed in a velvety spinach gravy, spiced with garam masala and cumin. This classic North Indian dish is both creamy and full of flavor, offering a perfect balance of richness and warmth.

hasMenuItem.name: VEDA SPECIAL PANEER LAVABDAR

hasMenuItem.name: PANEER ANGARA
hasMenuItem.description: Chunks of paneer marinated in a smoky, spicy blend of yogurt and masalas, then grilled to perfection. The fiery flavors of the marinade, combined with the charred, smoky exterior, make this a flavorful and satisfying vegetarian appetizer.

hasMenuItem.name: METHI MALAI MATAR
hasMenuItem.description: Soft cubes of paneer cooked in a creamy, fragrant gravy made with fenugreek leaves (methi), fresh cream, and aromatic spices. hasMenuItem.name: JAIN PANEER BUTTER MASALA

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN MATAR PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: Tender paneer cubes and green peas cooked in a mildly spiced tomato-based gravy, finished with a touch of cream.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN METHI MALAI PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: A comforting Jain classic made with tender paneer and aromatic methi, simmered in a smooth, mildly sweet cream-based gravy.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN METHI MALAI MATAR
hasMenuItem.description: Fresh methi leaves and tender green peas cooked in a velvety malai gravy, balanced with subtle spices to create a comforting and aromatic Jain-friendly dish.

hasMenuItem.name: BUTTER CHICKEN

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN TIKKA MASALA

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN LAVABDAR
hasMenuItem.description: Boneless chicken pieces cooked in a rich, creamy tomato and cashew-based gravy with aromatic spices. A mildly spiced North Indian delicacy, known for its smooth texture and royal flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: SAAG CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: Tender chicken simmered in a creamy spinach gravy with garlic, ginger, and mild spices. A hearty North Indian classic that blends rich flavor with wholesome greens.

hasMenuItem.name: KADAI CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: A flavorful North Indian curry made with tender chicken cooked in a wok-style pan (kadai) with onions, tomatoes, capsicum, and freshly ground spices. Known for its bold, smoky flavor and medium spice kick.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN BHUNA
hasMenuItem.description: Tender chicken cooked with onions, tomatoes, ginger, garlic, and a thick blend of aromatic spices. A rich, semi-dry curry known for its deep flavor and slow-cooked taste.

hasMenuItem.name: DESI CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: Traditional homestyle chicken curry cooked with bone-in pieces, onions, tomatoes, ginger, garlic, and a blend of rustic Indian spices. A flavorful dish that brings the authentic taste of Indian kitchens.

hasMenuItem.name: MUTTON CURRY
hasMenuItem.description: Hearty pieces of mutton simmered in a rich and flavorful curry sauce made with tomatoes, onions, and an array of spices. The tender meat is infused with the savory spices, creating a comforting, aromatic dish that's perfect with steamed rice or naan.

hasMenuItem.name: MUTTON ROGAN JOSH
hasMenuItem.description: A Kashmiri classic, this dish features tender mutton simmered in a rich, yogurt-based gravy with aromatic spices such as saffron and cinnamon. The dish offers a delicate, slightly spicy flavor profile that’s velvety and deeply fragrant, making it a truly indulgent meal.

hasMenuItem.name: KADAI MUTTON

hasMenuItem.name: DAL TADKA

hasMenuItem.name: ONIAN KULCHA

hasMenuItem.name: BULLET NAAN

hasMenuItem.name: VEG BIRYANI
hasMenuItem.description: Fragrant basmati rice layered with a medley of mixed vegetables and aromatic spices, cooked to perfection. This aromatic, flavorful dish is served with a side of cooling raita to balance the heat.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN DUM BIRYAN
hasMenuItem.description: A fragrant Hyderabadi-style biryani made with marinated chicken, long-grain basmati rice, caramelized onions, and aromatic spices, slow-cooked on dum for rich flavor and aroma. Served with raita.

hasMenuItem.name: MUTTON BIRYANI
hasMenuItem.description: A fragrant and flavorful layered rice dish with tender pieces of mutton, slow-cooked in a blend of spices and aromatic herbs. The rice is infused with the rich flavors of the meat, creating a mouthwatering experience, served with a cooling raita or pickle on the side.

hasMenuItem.name: JEERA RICE
hasMenuItem.description: Fragrant basmati rice cooked with cumin seeds, giving it a warm, earthy flavor with a light, aromatic fragrance. A simple yet perfect accompaniment to any curry or dish, offering a comforting balance of spices and texture.

hasMenuItem.name: STEAMED RICE
hasMenuItem.description: Fragrant, fluffy basmati rice, perfectly steamed to a light and airy texture. A classic side dish that complements any curry or gravy.

hasMenuItem.name: FRENCH FRIES
hasMenuItem.description: Crispy, golden fries dusted with a tantalizing mix of Indian spices—cumin, chili, and tangy chat masala. Perfectly spiced and irresistibly crunchy, these fries are a flavorful twist on a classic snack.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN NUGGETS & FRIES
hasMenuItem.description: Crispy golden chicken nuggets served with a side of hot French fries. A kid’s all-time favorite meal, simple and tasty.

hasMenuItem.name: MANGO LASSI
hasMenuItem.description: A refreshing blend of ripe mangoes and creamy yogurt, sweetened to perfection and chilled for a smooth, velvety texture. This tropical, tangy-sweet drink is the perfect way to cool down and complement any meal.

hasMenuItem.name: MASALA CHAAS
hasMenuItem.description: A light and refreshing yogurt-based drink seasoned with roasted cumin, ginger, green chili, and fresh coriander. Served chilled, this spiced buttermilk is the perfect cooling companion to any meal. ?

hasMenuItem.name: RAS MALAI
hasMenuItem.description: Soft paneer soaked in rich, sweetened cream, delicately flavored with cardamom and saffron. A creamy, indulgent dessert to finish your meal.

hasMenuItem.name: CARROT HALVA
hasMenuItem.description: A traditional Indian dessert made with grated carrots slow-cooked in milk, sugar, and ghee, flavored with cardamom, and garnished with nuts. A rich and comforting sweet treat.

hasMenuItem.name: GULAB JAMUN
hasMenuItem.description: Soft, melt-in-your-mouth milk-solid dumplings soaked in warm cardamom-infused sugar syrup. Served slightly warm for the perfect end to your meal.

hasMenuItem.name: CHILI CHICKEN

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN MANCHURIAN
hasMenuItem.description: Crispy chicken pieces tossed in a tangy, spicy Indo-Chinese sauce made with garlic, soy, chili, and spring onions. Perfect with fried rice or noodles.

hasMenuItem.name: EGG FRIED RICE

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN FRIED RICE

hasMenuItem.name: VEG FRIED NOODLES

hasMenuItem.name: VEG SCHEZWAN NOODLES

hasMenuItem.description: Small, baby potatoes slow-cooked in a fragrant, rich gravy made with yogurt, aromatic spices, and Kashmiri red chili. This dish offers a perfect balance of heat and creaminess, bringing the flavors of Kashmir to your plate in every bite.

This sweet and savory dish is delicately spiced and indulgently creamy, perfect for those seeking a vegetarian treat.

hasMenuItem.name: VEG DIWANI HANDI
hasMenuItem.description: A vibrant, mixed vegetable curry cooked in a rich, creamy gravy with a perfect balance of spices and herbs. Served in a traditional handi, this dish is both comforting and packed with flavors.

hasMenuItem.name: SAAG CHANA

hasMenuItem.name: CHANA MASALA

hasMenuItem.name: ALOO GOBI MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: A classic North Indian curry made with potatoes and cauliflower cooked in onions, tomatoes, ginger, and traditional spices. A hearty vegetarian favorite with homestyle flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: METHI MALAI MATAR

hasMenuItem.name: MALAI KOFTA

hasMenuItem.name: KADAI PANEER

hasMenuItem.name: SAAG PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: Soft cubes of paneer immersed in a velvety spinach gravy, spiced with garam masala and cumin. This classic North Indian dish is both creamy and full of flavor, offering a perfect balance of richness and warmth.

hasMenuItem.description: Chunks of paneer marinated in a smoky, spicy blend of yogurt and masalas, then grilled to perfection. The fiery flavors of the marinade, combined with the charred, smoky exterior, make this a flavorful and satisfying vegetarian appetizer.

hasMenuItem.name: METHI MALAI MATAR
hasMenuItem.description: Soft cubes of paneer cooked in a creamy, fragrant gravy made with fenugreek leaves (methi), fresh cream, and aromatic spices. This rich and savory dish balances the slight bitterness of methi with the smooth creaminess, offering a comforting and indulgent vegetarian delight.

hasMenuItem.name: PANEER BUTTER MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: Creamy, rich, and indulgent, this dish features soft cubes of paneer simmered in a velvety tomato-based gravy with butter, cream, and a delicate blend of spices. A classic favorite that pairs beautifully with naan or rice.

hasMenuItem.name: PANEER TIKKA MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: Tender cubes of marinated paneer grilled to perfection and then simmered in a rich, spiced tomato gravy. The dish is creamy, aromatic, and full of flavor, making it a favorite vegetarian curry in Indian cuisine.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN PANEER TIKKA MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: Char-grilled paneer tikka pieces simmered in a rich, creamy tomato-cashew gravy, delicately spiced for a flavorful Jain preparation.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN PANEER BUTTER MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: Soft paneer cubes simmered in a rich, buttery tomato-cashew gravy, finished with fresh cream for a smooth, mildly sweet Jain preparation.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN MATAR PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: Tender paneer cubes and green peas cooked in a mildly spiced tomato-based gravy, finished with a touch of cream.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN METHI MALAI PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: A comforting Jain classic made with tender paneer and aromatic methi, simmered in a smooth, mildly sweet cream-based gravy.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN METHI MALAI MATAR
hasMenuItem.description: Fresh methi leaves and tender green peas cooked in a velvety malai gravy, balanced with subtle spices to create a comforting and aromatic Jain-friendly dish.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN MALAI KOFTA

hasMenuItem.name: BUTTER CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: Juicy pieces of chicken cooked in a smooth tomato-butter sauce with cream and mild spices. A signature Indian favorite that’s rich, comforting, and mildly spiced.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN TIKKA MASALA

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN LAVABDAR
hasMenuItem.description: Boneless chicken pieces cooked in a rich, creamy tomato and cashew-based gravy with aromatic spices. A mildly spiced North Indian delicacy, known for its smooth texture and royal flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: SAAG CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: Tender chicken simmered in a creamy spinach gravy with garlic, ginger, and mild spices. A hearty North Indian classic that blends rich flavor with wholesome greens.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN BHUNA

hasMenuItem.name: DESI CHICKEN

hasMenuItem.description: Hearty pieces of mutton simmered in a rich and flavorful curry sauce made with tomatoes, onions, and an array of spices. The tender meat is infused with the savory spices, creating a comforting, aromatic dish that's perfect with steamed rice or naan.

hasMenuItem.name: MUTTON ROGAN JOSH
hasMenuItem.description: A Kashmiri classic, this dish features tender mutton simmered in a rich, yogurt-based gravy with aromatic spices such as saffron and cinnamon. The dish offers a delicate, slightly spicy flavor profile that’s velvety and deeply fragrant, making it a truly indulgent meal.

hasMenuItem.name: KADAI MUTTON

hasMenuItem.name: JEERA RICE

hasMenuItem.name: STEAMED RICE

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN NUGGETS & FRIES

hasMenuItem.name: MANGO LASSI
hasMenuItem.description: A refreshing blend of ripe mangoes and creamy yogurt, sweetened to perfection and chilled for a smooth, velvety texture. This tropical, tangy-sweet drink is the perfect way to cool down and complement any meal.

hasMenuItem.name: MASALA CHAAS
hasMenuItem.description: A light and refreshing yogurt-based drink seasoned with roasted cumin, ginger, green chili, and fresh coriander. Served chilled, this spiced buttermilk is the perfect cooling companion to any meal. ?

hasMenuItem.name: RAS MALAI
hasMenuItem.description: Soft paneer soaked in rich, sweetened cream, delicately flavored with cardamom and saffron. A creamy, indulgent dessert to finish your meal.

hasMenuItem.name: CARROT HALVA
hasMenuItem.description: A traditional Indian dessert made with grated carrots slow-cooked in milk, sugar, and ghee, flavored with cardamom, and garnished with nuts. A rich and comforting sweet treat.

hasMenuItem.name: GULAB JAMUN
hasMenuItem.description: Soft, melt-in-your-mouth milk-solid dumplings soaked in warm cardamom-infused sugar syrup. Served slightly warm for the perfect end to your meal.

hasMenuItem.name: AFGHANI PANEER

hasMenuItem.name: AJWAINI PANEER

hasMenuItem.name: TANDOORI PANEER TIKKA

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN 65

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN LOLIPOP DRY

hasMenuItem.name: GARLIC SHRIMP
hasMenuItem.description: Succulent shrimp sautéed with garlic, herbs, and spices, creating a savory and aromatic seafood dish.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN LOLIPOP GRAVY
hasMenuItem.description: Chicken wings marinated with Indian spices, deep-fried to a crisp, then tossed in a tangy, spicy Indo-Chinese style gravy made with garlic, soy, and chili sauce. A perfect fusion dish packed with flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: TANDOORI CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: Juicy chicken marinated in a blend of yogurt, spices, and herbs, then char-grilled to perfection in the tandoor. The smoky, spiced exterior and tender meat make this a classic favorite.

hasMenuItem.name: LAMB SEEKH KABAB
hasMenuItem.description: Minced lamb mixed with fresh herbs, spices, and a touch of yogurt, then shaped onto skewers and grilled to perfection. These juicy, flavorful kababs are tender on the inside, with a smoky, charred exterior, served with a side of tangy chutney.

hasMenuItem.name: LAMB CHOP
hasMenuItem.description: Juicy, tender lamb chops marinated in a fragrant mix of yogurt, garlic, ginger, and spices, then grilled or roasted to perfection. The crispy, charred exterior and soft, flavorful meat inside make this dish an irresistible treat for meat lovers.

hasMenuItem.name: TANDOORI SHRIMP
hasMenuItem.description: Succulent shrimp marinated in a flavorful blend of yogurt, spices, and herbs, then grilled in the tandoor to smoky perfection. The result is tender, slightly charred shrimp with a burst of aromatic, spiced flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN RESHMI KEBAB
hasMenuItem.description: ender chicken pieces marinated in yogurt, cream, and mild spices, then grilled in the tandoor for a soft, juicy, and melt-in-the-mouth kebab. A rich and flavorful Mughlai delicacy.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN TIKKA
hasMenuItem.description: Boneless pieces of chicken marinated in a spiced yogurt mixture, skewered, and grilled to perfection in the tandoor. With a crispy, smoky exterior and juicy interior, this flavorful dish is a crowd-pleaser.

hasMenuItem.name: GOBI MANCHURIAN
hasMenuItem.description: Crispy cauliflower florets tossed in a tangy Indo-Chinese sauce with garlic, ginger, soy, and spring onions. A bold and addictive street-style favorite with just the right balance of heat and flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: BABY CORN CHILI
hasMenuItem.description: Crisp baby corn tossed with onions, bell peppers, garlic, and green chilies in a tangy Indo-Chinese sauce. A delicious vegetarian appetizer with the perfect balance of spice and flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: VEG MANCHURIAN DRY
hasMenuItem.description: Crispy, bite-sized vegetable balls tossed in a tangy and spicy Indo-Chinese sauce with a hint of soy and chili. This dry version is packed with bold flavors and a delightful crunch.

hasMenuItem.name: PANEER CHILI
hasMenuItem.description: A spicy, tangy Indo-Chinese delight, this dish features paneer cubes tossed in a bold, wok-fried sauce with bell peppers, onions, and chili sauce. With a crispy exterior and a hint of sweetness, it’s a perfect balance of heat and flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: CHILI CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: Crispy fried chicken tossed with onions, bell peppers, green chilies, garlic, and soy sauce in a spicy Indo-Chinese style. Available in dry or gravy preparation, perfect with fried rice or noodles.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN MANCHURIAN
hasMenuItem.description: Crispy chicken pieces tossed in a tangy, spicy Indo-Chinese sauce made with garlic, soy, chili, and spring onions. Perfect with fried rice or noodles.

hasMenuItem.name: VEG FRIED RICE
hasMenuItem.description: Fragrant basmati rice stir-fried with mixed vegetables, soy sauce, and a blend of spices, creating a light, savory dish. A perfect side to any curry or Indo-Chinese dish.

hasMenuItem.name: EGG FRIED RICE
hasMenuItem.description: Fragrant basmati rice stir-fried with scrambled eggs, fresh vegetables, soy sauce, and spices. A simple yet flavorful Indo-Chinese classic.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN FRIED RICE
hasMenuItem.description: Fragrant basmati rice stir-fried with tender chicken, fresh vegetables, soy sauce, and spices. A classic Indo-Chinese favorite, perfect on its own or paired with gravy dishes.

hasMenuItem.name: VEG FRIED NOODLES
hasMenuItem.description: Stir-fried noodles tossed with fresh vegetables, soy sauce, and a medley of spices. This Indo-Chinese favorite is a savory, satisfying dish with a perfect balance of crispy and tender textures.

hasMenuItem.name: VEG SCHEZWAN RICE

hasMenuItem.name: VEG SCHEZWAN NOODLES

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN SCHEZWAN RICE

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN FRIED NOODLES

hasMenuItem.name: EGG FRIED NOODLES

hasMenuItem.name: GOBI MANCHURIAN GRAVY
hasMenuItem.description: Golden-fried cauliflower florets tossed in a flavorful Indo-Chinese gravy made with garlic, ginger, soy, and chili sauce. A spicy, tangy favorite that pairs perfectly with fried rice or noodles.

hasMenuItem.name: VEG MANCHURIAN GRAVY
hasMenuItem.description: Crispy vegetable dumplings made from cabbage, carrots, and spices, simmered in a tangy, spicy Indo-Chinese gravy with garlic, soy, and chili flavors. Best enjoyed with fried rice or noodles.

hasMenuItem.name: KASHMIRI DUM ALOO
hasMenuItem.description: Small, baby potatoes slow-cooked in a fragrant, rich gravy made with yogurt, aromatic spices, and Kashmiri red chili. This dish offers a perfect balance of heat and creaminess, bringing the flavors of Kashmir to your plate in every bite.

hasMenuItem.name: NAVRATNA KORMA
hasMenuItem.description: A royal, creamy curry made with a medley of nine different vegetables and fruits, including carrots, beans, and pineapple, all simmered in a rich, spiced gravy of yogurt, cream, and cashew paste. This sweet and savory dish is delicately spiced and indulgently creamy, perfect for those seeking a vegetarian treat.

hasMenuItem.name: MUSHROOM MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: A rich, flavorful curry featuring tender mushrooms cooked in a spiced gravy of tomatoes, onions, and aromatic spices. The earthy mushrooms absorb the aromatic masala, creating a hearty and satisfying vegetarian dish that's both comforting and packed with flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: VEG DIWANI HANDI
hasMenuItem.description: A vibrant, mixed vegetable curry cooked in a rich, creamy gravy with a perfect balance of spices and herbs. Served in a traditional handi, this dish is both comforting and packed with flavors.

hasMenuItem.name: AMRITSARI CHOLE
hasMenuItem.description: A traditional Punjabi specialty made with chickpeas simmered in a robust blend of onions, tomatoes, ginger, and aromatic spices. Rich, flavorful, and best enjoyed with bhature, naan, or rice.

hasMenuItem.name: SAAG CHANA
hasMenuItem.description: Tender chickpeas cooked in a rich, spiced spinach gravy. The earthy flavor of the chickpeas blends perfectly with the smooth, mildly spiced saag, creating a hearty and comforting dish.

hasMenuItem.name: CHANA MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: A hearty North Indian curry made with chickpeas simmered in onions, tomatoes, ginger, and a blend of traditional spices. A flavorful vegetarian favorite, best enjoyed with rice or bread.

hasMenuItem.name: ALOO GOBI MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: A classic North Indian curry made with potatoes and cauliflower cooked in onions, tomatoes, ginger, and traditional spices. A hearty vegetarian favorite with homestyle flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: METHI MALAI MATAR
hasMenuItem.description: A rich, creamy dish featuring tender green peas (matar) and fenugreek leaves (methi) cooked in a luscious, spiced gravy. The bitterness of methi is beautifully balanced with the sweetness of peas, creating a warm, satisfying curry.

hasMenuItem.name: MALAI KOFTA
hasMenuItem.description: Velvety spheres of paneer and potato, subtly spiced and cooked to perfection, immersed in a rich, creamy tomato-based gravy. The silky texture of the kofta combined with the luscious, aromatic sauce creates a decadent, indulgent dish that’s both comforting and flavorful.

hasMenuItem.name: KADAI PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: Soft cubes of paneer cooked in a fiery, tangy gravy made with bell peppers, onions, tomatoes, and a special blend of spices. The dish is simmered in a wok (kadai), which infuses the curry with a smoky depth, creating a vegetarian delight that’s rich in flavor and texture.

hasMenuItem.name: SAAG PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: Soft cubes of paneer immersed in a velvety spinach gravy, spiced with garam masala and cumin. This classic North Indian dish is both creamy and full of flavor, offering a perfect balance of richness and warmth.

hasMenuItem.name: PANEER BHURJI
hasMenuItem.description: Crumbled paneer cooked with onions, tomatoes, and a medley of spices. This savory, scrambled paneer dish is seasoned with cumin, turmeric, and garam masala, creating a hearty, flavorful dish that’s perfect for breakfast, lunch, or as a side.

hasMenuItem.name: MATAR PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: A classic North Indian dish featuring soft cubes of paneer and tender green peas simmered in a rich, spiced tomato-based gravy. Infused with warming spices like cumin, coriander, and garam masala, this comforting curry strikes the perfect balance between creamy, savory, and slightly sweet flavors.

hasMenuItem.name: VEDA SPECIAL PANEER LAVABDAR
hasMenuItem.description: Soft cubes of paneer cooked in a creamy, flavorful gravy made with tomatoes, onions, and a unique blend of spices. The dish is mildly spiced and indulgently smooth, making it a must-try vegetarian delicacy.

hasMenuItem.name: PANEER ANGARA
hasMenuItem.description: Chunks of paneer marinated in a smoky, spicy blend of yogurt and masalas, then grilled to perfection. The fiery flavors of the marinade, combined with the charred, smoky exterior, make this a flavorful and satisfying vegetarian appetizer.

hasMenuItem.name: METHI MALAI MATAR
hasMenuItem.description: Soft cubes of paneer cooked in a creamy, fragrant gravy made with fenugreek leaves (methi), fresh cream, and aromatic spices. This rich and savory dish balances the slight bitterness of methi with the smooth creaminess, offering a comforting and indulgent vegetarian delight.

hasMenuItem.name: PANEER BUTTER MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: Creamy, rich, and indulgent, this dish features soft cubes of paneer simmered in a velvety tomato-based gravy with butter, cream, and a delicate blend of spices. A classic favorite that pairs beautifully with naan or rice.

hasMenuItem.name: PANEER TIKKA MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: Tender cubes of marinated paneer grilled to perfection and then simmered in a rich, spiced tomato gravy. The dish is creamy, aromatic, and full of flavor, making it a favorite vegetarian curry in Indian cuisine.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN PANEER TIKKA MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: Char-grilled paneer tikka pieces simmered in a rich, creamy tomato-cashew gravy, delicately spiced for a flavorful Jain preparation.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN PANEER BUTTER MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: Soft paneer cubes simmered in a rich, buttery tomato-cashew gravy, finished with fresh cream for a smooth, mildly sweet Jain preparation.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN MATAR PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: Tender paneer cubes and green peas cooked in a mildly spiced tomato-based gravy, finished with a touch of cream.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN METHI MALAI PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: A comforting Jain classic made with tender paneer and aromatic methi, simmered in a smooth, mildly sweet cream-based gravy.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN METHI MALAI MATAR
hasMenuItem.description: Fresh methi leaves and tender green peas cooked in a velvety malai gravy, balanced with subtle spices to create a comforting and aromatic Jain-friendly dish.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN MALAI KOFTA
hasMenuItem.description: Soft paneer and vegetable koftas served in a rich, creamy cashew-malai gravy, delicately spiced for a smooth and comforting flavor.

hasMenuItem.description: Juicy, tender chicken simmered in a rich, aromatic gravy made from freshly ground spices, tomatoes, and a hint of cream. This signature curry is deeply flavorful with a perfect balance of heat and warmth, offering a comforting, authentic taste of India.

hasMenuItem.name: BUTTER CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: Juicy pieces of chicken cooked in a smooth tomato-butter sauce with cream and mild spices. A signature Indian favorite that’s rich, comforting, and mildly spiced.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN TIKKA MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: ender pieces of marinated chicken, roasted in the tandoor, then simmered in a rich and creamy tomato-onion sauce with aromatic spices. A classic North Indian favorite with bold flavor and smooth texture.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN LAVABDAR
hasMenuItem.description: Boneless chicken pieces cooked in a rich, creamy tomato and cashew-based gravy with aromatic spices. A mildly spiced North Indian delicacy, known for its smooth texture and royal flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: SAAG CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: Tender chicken simmered in a creamy spinach gravy with garlic, ginger, and mild spices. A hearty North Indian classic that blends rich flavor with wholesome greens.

hasMenuItem.name: KADAI CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: A flavorful North Indian curry made with tender chicken cooked in a wok-style pan (kadai) with onions, tomatoes, capsicum, and freshly ground spices. Known for its bold, smoky flavor and medium spice kick.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN BHUNA
hasMenuItem.description: Tender chicken cooked with onions, tomatoes, ginger, garlic, and a thick blend of aromatic spices. A rich, semi-dry curry known for its deep flavor and slow-cooked taste.

hasMenuItem.name: DESI CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: Traditional homestyle chicken curry cooked with bone-in pieces, onions, tomatoes, ginger, garlic, and a blend of rustic Indian spices. A flavorful dish that brings the authentic taste of Indian kitchens.

hasMenuItem.name: MUTTON CURRY
hasMenuItem.description: Hearty pieces of mutton simmered in a rich and flavorful curry sauce made with tomatoes, onions, and an array of spices. The tender meat is infused with the savory spices, creating a comforting, aromatic dish that's perfect with steamed rice or naan.

hasMenuItem.name: MUTTON ROGAN JOSH
hasMenuItem.description: A Kashmiri classic, this dish features tender mutton simmered in a rich, yogurt-based gravy with aromatic spices such as saffron and cinnamon. The dish offers a delicate, slightly spicy flavor profile that’s velvety and deeply fragrant, making it a truly indulgent meal.

hasMenuItem.name: KADAI MUTTON
hasMenuItem.description: Tender chunks of mutton slow-cooked in a rich, spiced gravy made with freshly ground spices, bell peppers, tomatoes, and a hint of garam masala. The dish is finished with a dash of coriander, giving it a bold, aromatic flavor perfect for mopping up with naan or rice.

hasMenuItem.name: LAMB ROGAN JOSH
hasMenuItem.description: A Kashmiri specialty, this aromatic curry features tender lamb simmered in a rich sauce of yogurt, tomatoes, and a unique blend of spices like saffron and cinnamon. The dish is subtly spiced, offering a velvety texture and deep, aromatic flavors.

hasMenuItem.name: VEDA SPCIAL LAMB

Infused with deep, earthy flavors, this dish is a house specialty, perfect for lamb lovers looking for a unique and savory experience.

hasMenuItem.name: LAMB BHUNA
hasMenuItem.description: Succulent pieces of lamb cooked in a robust, flavorful gravy made with caramelized onions, tomatoes, and a blend of traditional spices. The rich, thick sauce is simmered to perfection, creating a mouthwatering dish with a deep, savory taste and tender lamb.

hasMenuItem.name: VEDA SPECIAL DAL

hasMenuItem.name: DAL MAKHNI

hasMenuItem.name: DAL TADKA

hasMenuItem.name: PLAIN NAAN

hasMenuItem.name: GARLIC NAAN

hasMenuItem.name: GARLIC CHILLI NAAN

hasMenuItem.name: BUTTER NAAN

hasMenuItem.name: GARLIC TANDOORI ROTI

hasMenuItem.name: PANEER KULCHA

hasMenuItem.name: ONIAN KULCHA
hasMenuItem.description: Soft, fluffy flatbread stuffed with caramelized onions and seasoned with a hint of cumin and ajwain. Baked in the tandoor, this naan-like bread is aromatic, slightly crispy on the outside, and warm and savory inside—perfect for pairing with curries and dips.

hasMenuItem.name: MIX BREAD BASKET (3 PCS)
hasMenuItem.description: A delightful assortment of freshly baked naan breads, perfect for sharing. This basket includes warm, pillowy Butter Naan, aromatic Garlic Naan, and classic Plain Naan—each soft and perfectly charred from the tandoor, ideal for pairing with your favorite curries and dips.

hasMenuItem.name: BULLET NAAN
hasMenuItem.description: Soft tandoor-baked naan brushed with butter and loaded with green chilies and spices. A fiery twist on the classic naan, made for spice lovers. ?️

hasMenuItem.name: VEG BIRYANI
hasMenuItem.description: Fragrant basmati rice layered with a medley of mixed vegetables and aromatic spices, cooked to perfection. This aromatic, flavorful dish is served with a side of cooling raita to balance the heat.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN DUM BIRYAN
hasMenuItem.description: A fragrant Hyderabadi-style biryani made with marinated chicken, long-grain basmati rice, caramelized onions, and aromatic spices, slow-cooked on dum for rich flavor and aroma. Served with raita.

hasMenuItem.name: MUTTON BIRYANI
hasMenuItem.description: A fragrant and flavorful layered rice dish with tender pieces of mutton, slow-cooked in a blend of spices and aromatic herbs. The rice is infused with the rich flavors of the meat, creating a mouthwatering experience, served with a cooling raita or pickle on the side.

hasMenuItem.name: JEERA RICE
hasMenuItem.description: Fragrant basmati rice cooked with cumin seeds, giving it a warm, earthy flavor with a light, aromatic fragrance. A simple yet perfect accompaniment to any curry or dish, offering a comforting balance of spices and texture.

hasMenuItem.name: STEAMED RICE
hasMenuItem.description: Fragrant, fluffy basmati rice, perfectly steamed to a light and airy texture. A classic side dish that complements any curry or gravy.

hasMenuItem.name: FRENCH FRIES
hasMenuItem.description: Crispy, golden fries dusted with a tantalizing mix of Indian spices—cumin, chili, and tangy chat masala. Perfectly spiced and irresistibly crunchy, these fries are a flavorful twist on a classic snack.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN NUGGETS & FRIES
hasMenuItem.description: Crispy golden chicken nuggets served with a side of hot French fries. A kid’s all-time favorite meal, simple and tasty.

hasMenuItem.name: MANGO LASSI
hasMenuItem.description: A refreshing blend of ripe mangoes and creamy yogurt, sweetened to perfection and chilled for a smooth, velvety texture. This tropical, tangy-sweet drink is the perfect way to cool down and complement any meal.

hasMenuItem.name: MASALA CHAAS
hasMenuItem.description: A light and refreshing yogurt-based drink seasoned with roasted cumin, ginger, green chili, and fresh coriander. Served chilled, this spiced buttermilk is the perfect cooling companion to any meal. ?

hasMenuItem.name: RAS MALAI
hasMenuItem.description: Soft paneer soaked in rich, sweetened cream, delicately flavored with cardamom and saffron. A creamy, indulgent dessert to finish your meal.

hasMenuItem.name: CARROT HALVA
hasMenuItem.description: A traditional Indian dessert made with grated carrots slow-cooked in milk, sugar, and ghee, flavored with cardamom, and garnished with nuts. A rich and comforting sweet treat.

hasMenuItem.name: GULAB JAMUN
hasMenuItem.description: Soft, melt-in-your-mouth milk-solid dumplings soaked in warm cardamom-infused sugar syrup. Served slightly warm for the perfect end to your meal.

hasMenuItem.name: CHILI CHICKEN

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN MANCHURIAN

hasMenuItem.name: VEG FRIED RICE

hasMenuItem.name: EGG FRIED RICE

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN FRIED RICE

hasMenuItem.name: VEG FRIED NOODLES

hasMenuItem.description: Small, baby potatoes slow-cooked in a fragrant, rich gravy made with yogurt, aromatic spices, and Kashmiri red chili. This dish offers a perfect balance of heat and creaminess, bringing the flavors of Kashmir to your plate in every bite.

This sweet and savory dish is delicately spiced and indulgently creamy, perfect for those seeking a vegetarian treat.

hasMenuItem.name: VEG DIWANI HANDI
hasMenuItem.description: A vibrant, mixed vegetable curry cooked in a rich, creamy gravy with a perfect balance of spices and herbs. Served in a traditional handi, this dish is both comforting and packed with flavors.

hasMenuItem.name: SAAG CHANA

hasMenuItem.name: CHANA MASALA

hasMenuItem.name: ALOO GOBI MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: A classic North Indian curry made with potatoes and cauliflower cooked in onions, tomatoes, ginger, and traditional spices. A hearty vegetarian favorite with homestyle flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: METHI MALAI MATAR

hasMenuItem.name: MALAI KOFTA

hasMenuItem.name: KADAI PANEER

hasMenuItem.name: SAAG PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: Soft cubes of paneer immersed in a velvety spinach gravy, spiced with garam masala and cumin. This classic North Indian dish is both creamy and full of flavor, offering a perfect balance of richness and warmth.

hasMenuItem.description: Chunks of paneer marinated in a smoky, spicy blend of yogurt and masalas, then grilled to perfection. The fiery flavors of the marinade, combined with the charred, smoky exterior, make this a flavorful and satisfying vegetarian appetizer.

hasMenuItem.name: METHI MALAI MATAR
hasMenuItem.description: Soft cubes of paneer cooked in a creamy, fragrant gravy made with fenugreek leaves (methi), fresh cream, and aromatic spices. This rich and savory dish balances the slight bitterness of methi with the smooth creaminess, offering a comforting and indulgent vegetarian delight.

hasMenuItem.name: PANEER BUTTER MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: Creamy, rich, and indulgent, this dish features soft cubes of paneer simmered in a velvety tomato-based gravy with butter, cream, and a delicate blend of spices. A classic favorite that pairs beautifully with naan or rice.

hasMenuItem.name: PANEER TIKKA MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: Tender cubes of marinated paneer grilled to perfection and then simmered in a rich, spiced tomato gravy. The dish is creamy, aromatic, and full of flavor, making it a favorite vegetarian curry in Indian cuisine.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN PANEER TIKKA MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: Char-grilled paneer tikka pieces simmered in a rich, creamy tomato-cashew gravy, delicately spiced for a flavorful Jain preparation.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN PANEER BUTTER MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: Soft paneer cubes simmered in a rich, buttery tomato-cashew gravy, finished with fresh cream for a smooth, mildly sweet Jain preparation.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN MATAR PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: Tender paneer cubes and green peas cooked in a mildly spiced tomato-based gravy, finished with a touch of cream.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN METHI MALAI PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: A comforting Jain classic made with tender paneer and aromatic methi, simmered in a smooth, mildly sweet cream-based gravy.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN METHI MALAI MATAR
hasMenuItem.description: Fresh methi leaves and tender green peas cooked in a velvety malai gravy, balanced with subtle spices to create a comforting and aromatic Jain-friendly dish.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN MALAI KOFTA

hasMenuItem.name: BUTTER CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: Juicy pieces of chicken cooked in a smooth tomato-butter sauce with cream and mild spices. A signature Indian favorite that’s rich, comforting, and mildly spiced.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN TIKKA MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: ender pieces of marinated chicken, roasted in the tandoor, then simmered in a rich and creamy tomato-onion sauce with aromatic spices. A classic North Indian favorite with bold flavor and smooth texture.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN LAVABDAR
hasMenuItem.description: Boneless chicken pieces cooked in a rich, creamy tomato and cashew-based gravy with aromatic spices. A mildly spiced North Indian delicacy, known for its smooth texture and royal flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: SAAG CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: Tender chicken simmered in a creamy spinach gravy with garlic, ginger, and mild spices. A hearty North Indian classic that blends rich flavor with wholesome greens.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN BHUNA

hasMenuItem.name: DESI CHICKEN

hasMenuItem.name: MUTTON CURRY
hasMenuItem.description: Hearty pieces of mutton simmered in a rich and flavorful curry sauce made with tomatoes, onions, and an array of spices. The tender meat is infused with the savory spices, creating a comforting, aromatic dish that's perfect with steamed rice or naan.

hasMenuItem.description: A Kashmiri classic, this dish features tender mutton simmered in a rich, yogurt-based gravy with aromatic spices such as saffron and cinnamon. The dish offers a delicate, slightly spicy flavor profile that’s velvety and deeply fragrant, making it a truly indulgent meal.

hasMenuItem.name: KADAI MUTTON

hasMenuItem.name: JEERA RICE

hasMenuItem.name: STEAMED RICE

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN NUGGETS & FRIES

hasMenuItem.name: MANGO LASSI
hasMenuItem.description: A refreshing blend of ripe mangoes and creamy yogurt, sweetened to perfection and chilled for a smooth, velvety texture. This tropical, tangy-sweet drink is the perfect way to cool down and complement any meal.

hasMenuItem.name: MASALA CHAAS
hasMenuItem.description: A light and refreshing yogurt-based drink seasoned with roasted cumin, ginger, green chili, and fresh coriander. Served chilled, this spiced buttermilk is the perfect cooling companion to any meal. ?

hasMenuItem.name: RAS MALAI
hasMenuItem.description: Soft paneer soaked in rich, sweetened cream, delicately flavored with cardamom and saffron. A creamy, indulgent dessert to finish your meal.

hasMenuItem.name: CARROT HALVA
hasMenuItem.description: A traditional Indian dessert made with grated carrots slow-cooked in milk, sugar, and ghee, flavored with cardamom, and garnished with nuts. A rich and comforting sweet treat.

hasMenuItem.name: GULAB JAMUN
hasMenuItem.description: Soft, melt-in-your-mouth milk-solid dumplings soaked in warm cardamom-infused sugar syrup. Served slightly warm for the perfect end to your meal.

hasMenuItem.name: TANDOORI PANEER TIKKA

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN 65

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN LOLIPOP DRY

hasMenuItem.name: GARLIC SHRIMP
hasMenuItem.description: Succulent shrimp sautéed with garlic, herbs, and spices, creating a savory and aromatic seafood dish.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN LOLIPOP GRAVY
hasMenuItem.description: Chicken wings marinated with Indian spices, deep-fried to a crisp, then tossed in a tangy, spicy Indo-Chinese style gravy made with garlic, soy, and chili sauce. A perfect fusion dish packed with flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: TANDOORI CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: Juicy chicken marinated in a blend of yogurt, spices, and herbs, then char-grilled to perfection in the tandoor. The smoky, spiced exterior and tender meat make this a classic favorite.

hasMenuItem.name: LAMB SEEKH KABAB
hasMenuItem.description: Minced lamb mixed with fresh herbs, spices, and a touch of yogurt, then shaped onto skewers and grilled to perfection. These juicy, flavorful kababs are tender on the inside, with a smoky, charred exterior, served with a side of tangy chutney.

hasMenuItem.name: LAMB CHOP
hasMenuItem.description: Juicy, tender lamb chops marinated in a fragrant mix of yogurt, garlic, ginger, and spices, then grilled or roasted to perfection. The crispy, charred exterior and soft, flavorful meat inside make this dish an irresistible treat for meat lovers.

hasMenuItem.name: TANDOORI SHRIMP
hasMenuItem.description: Succulent shrimp marinated in a flavorful blend of yogurt, spices, and herbs, then grilled in the tandoor to smoky perfection. The result is tender, slightly charred shrimp with a burst of aromatic, spiced flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN RESHMI KEBAB
hasMenuItem.description: ender chicken pieces marinated in yogurt, cream, and mild spices, then grilled in the tandoor for a soft, juicy, and melt-in-the-mouth kebab. A rich and flavorful Mughlai delicacy.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN TIKKA
hasMenuItem.description: Boneless pieces of chicken marinated in a spiced yogurt mixture, skewered, and grilled to perfection in the tandoor. With a crispy, smoky exterior and juicy interior, this flavorful dish is a crowd-pleaser.

hasMenuItem.name: GOBI MANCHURIAN
hasMenuItem.description: Crispy cauliflower florets tossed in a tangy Indo-Chinese sauce with garlic, ginger, soy, and spring onions. A bold and addictive street-style favorite with just the right balance of heat and flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: BABY CORN CHILI
hasMenuItem.description: Crisp baby corn tossed with onions, bell peppers, garlic, and green chilies in a tangy Indo-Chinese sauce. A delicious vegetarian appetizer with the perfect balance of spice and flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: VEG MANCHURIAN DRY

hasMenuItem.name: PANEER CHILI
hasMenuItem.description: A spicy, tangy Indo-Chinese delight, this dish features paneer cubes tossed in a bold, wok-fried sauce with bell peppers, onions, and chili sauce. With a crispy exterior and a hint of sweetness, it’s a perfect balance of heat and flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: CHILI CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: Crispy fried chicken tossed with onions, bell peppers, green chilies, garlic, and soy sauce in a spicy Indo-Chinese style. Available in dry or gravy preparation, perfect with fried rice or noodles.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN MANCHURIAN
hasMenuItem.description: Crispy chicken pieces tossed in a tangy, spicy Indo-Chinese sauce made with garlic, soy, chili, and spring onions. Perfect with fried rice or noodles.

hasMenuItem.name: VEG FRIED RICE
hasMenuItem.description: Fragrant basmati rice stir-fried with mixed vegetables, soy sauce, and a blend of spices, creating a light, savory dish. A perfect side to any curry or Indo-Chinese dish.

hasMenuItem.name: EGG FRIED RICE
hasMenuItem.description: Fragrant basmati rice stir-fried with scrambled eggs, fresh vegetables, soy sauce, and spices. A simple yet flavorful Indo-Chinese classic.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN FRIED RICE
hasMenuItem.description: Fragrant basmati rice stir-fried with tender chicken, fresh vegetables, soy sauce, and spices. A classic Indo-Chinese favorite, perfect on its own or paired with gravy dishes.

hasMenuItem.name: VEG FRIED NOODLES
hasMenuItem.description: Stir-fried noodles tossed with fresh vegetables, soy sauce, and a medley of spices. This Indo-Chinese favorite is a savory, satisfying dish with a perfect balance of crispy and tender textures.

hasMenuItem.name: VEG SCHEZWAN RICE

hasMenuItem.name: VEG SCHEZWAN NOODLES

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN SCHEZWAN RICE

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN FRIED NOODLES

hasMenuItem.name: EGG FRIED NOODLES

hasMenuItem.name: GOBI MANCHURIAN GRAVY
hasMenuItem.description: Golden-fried cauliflower florets tossed in a flavorful Indo-Chinese gravy made with garlic, ginger, soy, and chili sauce. A spicy, tangy favorite that pairs perfectly with fried rice or noodles.

hasMenuItem.name: VEG MANCHURIAN GRAVY
hasMenuItem.description: Crispy vegetable dumplings made from cabbage, carrots, and spices, simmered in a tangy, spicy Indo-Chinese gravy with garlic, soy, and chili flavors. Best enjoyed with fried rice or noodles.

hasMenuItem.name: KASHMIRI DUM ALOO
hasMenuItem.description: Small, baby potatoes slow-cooked in a fragrant, rich gravy made with yogurt, aromatic spices, and Kashmiri red chili. This dish offers a perfect balance of heat and creaminess, bringing the flavors of Kashmir to your plate in every bite.

hasMenuItem.name: NAVRATNA KORMA
hasMenuItem.description: A royal, creamy curry made with a medley of nine different vegetables and fruits, including carrots, beans, and pineapple, all simmered in a rich, spiced gravy of yogurt, cream, and cashew paste. This sweet and savory dish is delicately spiced and indulgently creamy, perfect for those seeking a vegetarian treat.

hasMenuItem.name: MUSHROOM MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: A rich, flavorful curry featuring tender mushrooms cooked in a spiced gravy of tomatoes, onions, and aromatic spices. The earthy mushrooms absorb the aromatic masala, creating a hearty and satisfying vegetarian dish that's both comforting and packed with flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: VEG DIWANI HANDI
hasMenuItem.description: A vibrant, mixed vegetable curry cooked in a rich, creamy gravy with a perfect balance of spices and herbs. Served in a traditional handi, this dish is both comforting and packed with flavors.

hasMenuItem.name: AMRITSARI CHOLE
hasMenuItem.description: A traditional Punjabi specialty made with chickpeas simmered in a robust blend of onions, tomatoes, ginger, and aromatic spices. Rich, flavorful, and best enjoyed with bhature, naan, or rice.

hasMenuItem.name: SAAG CHANA
hasMenuItem.description: Tender chickpeas cooked in a rich, spiced spinach gravy. The earthy flavor of the chickpeas blends perfectly with the smooth, mildly spiced saag, creating a hearty and comforting dish.

hasMenuItem.name: CHANA MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: A hearty North Indian curry made with chickpeas simmered in onions, tomatoes, ginger, and a blend of traditional spices. A flavorful vegetarian favorite, best enjoyed with rice or bread.

hasMenuItem.name: ALOO GOBI MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: A classic North Indian curry made with potatoes and cauliflower cooked in onions, tomatoes, ginger, and traditional spices. A hearty vegetarian favorite with homestyle flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: METHI MALAI MATAR
hasMenuItem.description: A rich, creamy dish featuring tender green peas (matar) and fenugreek leaves (methi) cooked in a luscious, spiced gravy. The bitterness of methi is beautifully balanced with the sweetness of peas, creating a warm, satisfying curry.

hasMenuItem.name: MALAI KOFTA
hasMenuItem.description: Velvety spheres of paneer and potato, subtly spiced and cooked to perfection, immersed in a rich, creamy tomato-based gravy. The silky texture of the kofta combined with the luscious, aromatic sauce creates a decadent, indulgent dish that’s both comforting and flavorful.

hasMenuItem.name: KADAI PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: Soft cubes of paneer cooked in a fiery, tangy gravy made with bell peppers, onions, tomatoes, and a special blend of spices. The dish is simmered in a wok (kadai), which infuses the curry with a smoky depth, creating a vegetarian delight that’s rich in flavor and texture.

hasMenuItem.name: SAAG PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: Soft cubes of paneer immersed in a velvety spinach gravy, spiced with garam masala and cumin. This classic North Indian dish is both creamy and full of flavor, offering a perfect balance of richness and warmth.

hasMenuItem.name: PANEER BHURJI
hasMenuItem.description: Crumbled paneer cooked with onions, tomatoes, and a medley of spices. This savory, scrambled paneer dish is seasoned with cumin, turmeric, and garam masala, creating a hearty, flavorful dish that’s perfect for breakfast, lunch, or as a side.

hasMenuItem.name: MATAR PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: A classic North Indian dish featuring soft cubes of paneer and tender green peas simmered in a rich, spiced tomato-based gravy. Infused with warming spices like cumin, coriander, and garam masala, this comforting curry strikes the perfect balance between creamy, savory, and slightly sweet flavors.

hasMenuItem.name: VEDA SPECIAL PANEER LAVABDAR
hasMenuItem.description: Soft cubes of paneer cooked in a creamy, flavorful gravy made with tomatoes, onions, and a unique blend of spices. The dish is mildly spiced and indulgently smooth, making it a must-try vegetarian delicacy.

hasMenuItem.name: PANEER ANGARA
hasMenuItem.description: Chunks of paneer marinated in a smoky, spicy blend of yogurt and masalas, then grilled to perfection. The fiery flavors of the marinade, combined with the charred, smoky exterior, make this a flavorful and satisfying vegetarian appetizer.

hasMenuItem.name: METHI MALAI MATAR
hasMenuItem.description: Soft cubes of paneer cooked in a creamy, fragrant gravy made with fenugreek leaves (methi), fresh cream, and aromatic spices. This rich and savory dish balances the slight bitterness of methi with the smooth creaminess, offering a comforting and indulgent vegetarian delight.

hasMenuItem.name: PANEER BUTTER MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: Creamy, rich, and indulgent, this dish features soft cubes of paneer simmered in a velvety tomato-based gravy with butter, cream, and a delicate blend of spices. A classic favorite that pairs beautifully with naan or rice.

hasMenuItem.name: PANEER TIKKA MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: Tender cubes of marinated paneer grilled to perfection and then simmered in a rich, spiced tomato gravy. The dish is creamy, aromatic, and full of flavor, making it a favorite vegetarian curry in Indian cuisine.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN PANEER TIKKA MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: Char-grilled paneer tikka pieces simmered in a rich, creamy tomato-cashew gravy, delicately spiced for a flavorful Jain preparation.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN PANEER BUTTER MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: Soft paneer cubes simmered in a rich, buttery tomato-cashew gravy, finished with fresh cream for a smooth, mildly sweet Jain preparation.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN MATAR PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: Tender paneer cubes and green peas cooked in a mildly spiced tomato-based gravy, finished with a touch of cream.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN METHI MALAI PANEER
hasMenuItem.description: A comforting Jain classic made with tender paneer and aromatic methi, simmered in a smooth, mildly sweet cream-based gravy.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN METHI MALAI MATAR
hasMenuItem.description: Fresh methi leaves and tender green peas cooked in a velvety malai gravy, balanced with subtle spices to create a comforting and aromatic Jain-friendly dish.

hasMenuItem.name: JAIN MALAI KOFTA
hasMenuItem.description: Soft paneer and vegetable koftas served in a rich, creamy cashew-malai gravy, delicately spiced for a smooth and comforting flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: BUTTER CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: Juicy pieces of chicken cooked in a smooth tomato-butter sauce with cream and mild spices. A signature Indian favorite that’s rich, comforting, and mildly spiced.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN TIKKA MASALA
hasMenuItem.description: ender pieces of marinated chicken, roasted in the tandoor, then simmered in a rich and creamy tomato-onion sauce with aromatic spices. A classic North Indian favorite with bold flavor and smooth texture.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN LAVABDAR
hasMenuItem.description: Boneless chicken pieces cooked in a rich, creamy tomato and cashew-based gravy with aromatic spices. A mildly spiced North Indian delicacy, known for its smooth texture and royal flavor.

hasMenuItem.name: SAAG CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: Tender chicken simmered in a creamy spinach gravy with garlic, ginger, and mild spices. A hearty North Indian classic that blends rich flavor with wholesome greens.

hasMenuItem.name: KADAI CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: A flavorful North Indian curry made with tender chicken cooked in a wok-style pan (kadai) with onions, tomatoes, capsicum, and freshly ground spices. Known for its bold, smoky flavor and medium spice kick.

hasMenuItem.name: CHICKEN BHUNA
hasMenuItem.description: Tender chicken cooked with onions, tomatoes, ginger, garlic, and a thick blend of aromatic spices. A rich, semi-dry curry known for its deep flavor and slow-cooked taste.

hasMenuItem.name: DESI CHICKEN
hasMenuItem.description: Traditional homestyle chicken curry cooked with bone-in pieces, onions, tomatoes, ginger, garlic, and a blend of rustic Indian spices. A flavorful dish that brings the authentic taste of Indian kitchens.

hasMenuItem.name: MUTTON CURRY
hasMenuItem.description: Hearty pieces of mutton simmered in a rich and flavorful curry sauce made with tomatoes, onions, and an array of spices. The tender meat is infused with the savory spices, creating a comforting, aromatic dish that's perfect with steamed rice or naan.

hasMenuItem.name: MUTTON ROGAN JOSH
hasMenuItem.description: A Kashmiri classic, this dish features tender mutton simmered in a rich, yogurt-based gravy with aromatic spices such as saffron and cinnamon. The dish offers a delicate, slightly spicy flavor profile that’s velvety and deeply fragrant, making it a truly indulgent meal.

hasMenuItem.name: KADAI MUTTON
hasMenuItem.description: Tender chunks of mutton slow-cooked in a rich, spiced gravy made with freshly ground spices, bell peppers, tomatoes, and a hint of garam masala. The dish is finished with a dash of coriander, giving it a bold, aromatic flavor perfect for mopping up with naan or rice.

hasMenuItem.name: LAMB ROGAN JOSH
hasMenuItem.description: A Kashmiri specialty, this aromatic curry features tender lamb simmered in a rich sauce of yogurt, tomatoes, and a unique blend of spices like saffron and cinnamon. The dish is subtly spiced, offering a velvety texture and deep, aromatic flavors.

hasMenuItem.name: VEDA SPCIAL LAMB

Infused with deep, earthy flavors, this dish is a house specialty, perfect for lamb lovers looking for a unique and savory experience.

hasMenuItem.name: LAMB BHUNA

hasMenuItem.name: VEDA SPECIAL DAL

hasMenuItem.name: DAL MAKHNI

hasMenuItem.name: DAL TADKA

hasMenuItem.name: PLAIN NAAN

hasMenuItem.name: GARLIC NAAN

hasMenuItem.name: GARLIC CHILLI NAAN

hasMenuItem.name: BUTTER NAAN
